title: indigofera paniculata subsp. gazensis
intro: Indigofera paniculata subsp. gazensis, commonly known as the "Gazelle Calf Plant", is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and pain, as well as being used as an antidote for snake bites. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include being an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic. The bioactive constituents of Indigofera paniculata subsp. gazensis include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
